name: Badam milk (milk with almonds, sugar and saffron)

source.name: Swasthi's Recipes (indianhealthyrecipes.com)
source.license: Ingredient amounts as listed in the cited recipe, converted to grams; nutrients composed from USDA FoodData Central (CC0)

notes: Serves 2. 20 to 24 almonds taken as 22 at 1.2 g = 26 g, soaked and peeled (blanched almonds); 500 ml (2 cups) whole milk taken as 488 g; 2 tsp sugar 8 g; a pinch of saffron 0.05 g; 1/8 tsp cardamom 0.3 g. The almond soaking water is discarded and not counted. About 5% lost as steam while simmering.
